```text
Usage of github-insights:
  -config string
    	Path to YAML config file (default: config.yaml if present)
  -end value
    	End date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to now)
  -maintained value
    	Maintained repo list (repeatable, or comma-separated)
  -out value
    	Output directory for JSON files
  -start value
    	Start date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD)
  -token value
    	GitHub token (optional; overrides GITHUB_TOKEN and config file)
  -username value
    	GitHub username to query (overrides GITHUB_USERNAME and config file)
  -verbose
    	Enable verbose (debug-level) logging
```
